trans-unit.target: TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_SEQ_00<tab>Ketenramm is considering your next steps.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_TODO_00<tab>Examine confluences.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_TODO_01<tab>Speak with the Archive.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_001<tab>The Forked Towers are the largest structures on the island. As such, they also store the lion's share of knowledge and relics.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_IRIS_000_005<tab>The towers may have helped shape the Occult Crescent as we know it, but that is not the whole story...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_010<tab>So, the isle's aetherial currents are in disarray...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_011<tab>Come to think of it, the landscape here is completely different to what we saw down south. It feels warped─unnatural even.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_012<tab>We ought to investigate what caused those changes.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_013<tab>And I suggest we start by surveyin' multiple confluences. That should give us a clearer picture of what's happenin' at the aetherial level.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_014<tab>I've a mind to accompany you on your excursion. That way I can immediately share what the seal's undoing reveals at each site.

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_015<tab>No need to pay me any heed, though. In the interest of avoiding my untimely demise at the hands of some fell fiend, I shall follow stealthily at a safe distance.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_016<tab>In that case, I'll stay put. I suggest ye concentrate yer search on the ruins in the area, and check for any abnormalities.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_020<tab>Judgin' by our scouts' reports, the ambient aether is densest around the ruins. Methinks they'll be yer best bet for findin' any confluences.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_025<tab>I've no idea why, but I've become rather adept at skulking through the shadows since being afflicted thus. You shan't even know I'm following you!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_IRIS_000_030<tab>I think I shall join you too...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_100<tab>This sprawling structure bears all the hallmarks of Skallic craftsmanship, but my eye is drawn to the extensive flooding...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_101<tab>A surfeit of water-aspected aether appears to have disrupted the area's natural balance.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_102<tab>Hmmm. One of the crew told me that the ancient city of Skalla now lies at the bottom of a loch.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_103<tab>Though I state the obvious, 'twas not always so. The city's submerged state is the result of a calamitous flood─not some architectural quirk.

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_104<tab>In other words, if one sought a faithful reproduction of Skallic civilization as it stood in the Fifth Astral Era, replicating the subsequent flood would be completely anachronistic...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_105<tab>Well, at least we have further evidence of aetherial abnormalities. Onward, to the next ruin!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_106<tab>Well, I've now seen enough to support my hypothesis, and I imagine Ketenramm will wish to hear of it too. Let us return to the camp posthaste.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_107<tab>Ah, not even the ravages of time can dim the allure of Nymian ingenuity.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_108<tab>Of course, the Nym of my time was not so...unconcerned with gravity.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_109<tab>This strange, floating aspect was not an inherent feature of the city. Though, having examined the confluence, the underlying phenomenon is clear.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_110<tab>Excess wind energies have weakened the bonds between building and ground, creating the landscape you see before you.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_111<tab>Intriguingly, this result seems somehow intentional... But that hardly aligns with the goal of accurately preserving Fifth Astral Era history.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_112<tab>Alas, there's not much else to glean from this confluence. Let us seek out other ruins!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_113<tab>Well, I've now seen enough to support my hypothesis, and I imagine Ketenramm will wish to hear of it too. Let us return to the camp posthaste.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_114<tab><cough> Something tells me we ought not linger here...

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_115<tab>Thankfully I was able to examine several aetherial flows en route. Something has sapped the area's earth-aspected energies, leading to a decline in the purifying potential of the soil, and a veritable mold invasion!

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_116<tab>Now, I understand that the Lost City of Amdapor is likewise riddled with rot. Yet I find it difficult to believe those moldering forces could sweep as far as here.

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_117<tab>Not only is the North Horn isolated from the rest of the isle, the Occult Crescent itself is malms away from the nearest port. Besides, if those foul spores <var 1A 02 /var>had<var 1A 01 /var> somehow spread here, I would expect the entire region to be infested...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_118<tab>At least we are beginning to glimpse the sheer extent of the environmental decay. 'Tis fortunate the nearby aetherial currents were still somewhat detectable.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_119<tab>On that note, I suggest we take our leave of these streets before we ourselves sprout moldy growths! More ruins─<cough>─await!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_120<tab>Well, I've now seen enough to support my hypothesis, and I imagine Ketenramm will wish to hear of it too. Let us return to the camp posthaste.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_121<tab>On this occasion, I scarcely need to examine the confluence─it is all too clear the vicinity is being subsumed by the void.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_122<tab>In ancient Mhach, mages would infuse their ceremonial chambers with astral-aspected aether to facilitate their summoning arts.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_124<tab>But that's not to imply the city was overrun with summoned voidsent. If this settlement lies in such a state, it can only mean one thing...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_126<tab>My theories can wait, however. There are more ruins to explore!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_127<tab>Well, I've now seen enough to support my hypothesis, and I imagine Ketenramm will wish to hear of it too. Let us return to the camp posthaste.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_130<tab>You know, I watched the Archive head back to camp from up here. He was threadin' his way through packs of fiends with surprisin' grace!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_IRIS_000_135<tab>The Archive's seal continues to crumble...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_200<tab>Phew! That was quite the journey. I'm not sure I'd have made it without you.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_201<tab>Now, all the ruins we saw exhibited aetherial abnormalities.

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_000_202<tab>The Nymian remains now float skyward due to excess wind energies, and the Skallic structure was inundated with water, while the Amdapori and Mhachi remnants are beset by earth- and astral-aspected imbalances, respectively. I also sense that the area surrounding the camp has been parched dry by an excess of fire-aspected aether...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_100_202<tab>In short, the aetherial balance of the North Horn has completely collapsed.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_200_202<tab>I believe the architect used the region to model the impact of such drastic aetherial changes.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_Q1_000_000<tab>What will you say?
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_A1_000_001<tab>The ruins here met a similar fate to their Eorzean counterparts.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_A1_000_002<tab>It's as if he intentionally replicated the wounds inflicted during the War of the Magi...

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_300_202<tab>To what end the architect conducted this experiment, I do not know. But these conditions stem from excessive use of aether in accordance with each civilization's unique history.

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_203<tab>Perhaps disruptin' the flow of aether to the Tower of Magic was part of his plan, then? Not that I have the foggiest idea <var 1A 02 /var>why<var 1A 01 /var> he'd want to...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_100_203<tab>Nor have I. To jeopardize precious remnants of the Fifth Astral Era in this way contradicts the isle's very purpose...

TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_ARCHIVE_200_203<tab>Regardless, if your theory is correct, I'm afraid we'll have a difficult time tracking down the tower via aetherial flows. Though the fact the pavilion exists at all ought to provide <var 1A 02 /var>some<var 1A 01 /var> encouragement...
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_000_204<tab>Are ye suggestin' there might be an aetherial node and means of activatin' it after all?
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_100_204<tab>Heh. I love a good mystery as much as the next fellow, but we're practically drownin' in the bleedin' things!
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_KETENRAMM_200_204<tab>Anyroad, before we get to solvin' them, I reckon we ought to take stock of what we've gleaned so far.
